description: PAID ($0.0027 USDC via x402, paid automatically). How to reach the organisation behind a website, read from its own HTML (the homepage, plus its contact page when linked): social profiles (X, LinkedIn company pages, GitHub, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Telegram, Discord, Reddit, Farcaster, Bluesky…), role email addresses (info@, sales@, support@, press@…), phone numbers from tel: links, and contact-page URLs. Addresses that look like a person's are never returned — only counted. Up to 3 redirects followed, each safety-checked; JavaScript is not run (a JavaScript-only page answers 422, not charged). Any answer the tool cannot produce is >= 400 and is NOT charged.

payment.description: Base64 of a single x402 v2 PaymentPayload you signed yourself. OPTIONAL: with AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY set, this tool pays automatically and you never need it. Use it to pay from a DIFFERENT wallet, or when no key is configured — call once without it to get the 402 (its body carries `howToPay.payloadTemplate`, the exact envelope to sign), then call again with it. When set it is sent as-is as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header; no local signing and no price ceiling are applied.
